full_prompt_en: A square view of a painted urban mural shows a skeletal knight riding a blue-grey horse in front of a vivid red rectangular field. The painting occupies a weathered masonry wall, with visible block seams, scuffed pigment and narrow grey borders around the red area. A strip of real dry grass and rough pavement runs along the foot of the wall. Within the mural, the horse faces left, its pointed ears and long muzzle outlined against the warm background. Cool teal and slate planes model its neck, chest and body, while dark reins loop from its head towards the rider. The rider sits upright in blue-grey armour with muted ochre accents at the waist and joints. A bare pale blue skull faces left above the armoured shoulders, its dark eye sockets and teeth clearly marked. A deep red cloak falls from the shoulders down the right side of the mounted figure. One bent leg is visible against the horse, and the lower forms partly merge with painted grass and low silhouettes along the mural's base. A long ochre shaft crosses diagonally from the lower middle towards the upper right, ending in a broad pointed spearhead. Behind the skull, an uneven pale orange circular ring is partly concealed by the figure and shaft, with red remaining visible inside it. Dark blue skyline-like shapes rise along the bottom, especially to the left, where thin towers contrast with the horse's broad body. Small scattered marks interrupt the otherwise red field. The painted forms use broad angular colour planes and selective shadows, while the wall's rough grid remains visible through the image. Even ambient light reveals both the mural and its masonry surface. The red rectangle, circular halo-like ring and long diagonal spear organize a compact mounted silhouette into a bold, weathered street-art composition.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形城市壁画视图，蓝灰色马背上的骷髅骑士映在鲜红矩形色域前。画作覆盖一面旧砌块墙，红色区域周围有狭窄灰边，墙块接缝、磨损颜料都清楚可见。墙脚横着一条真实枯草与粗糙铺地。壁画中的马朝向左方，尖耳与长口鼻在暖色背景前形成轮廓。冷青绿和石板灰块面塑造马颈、胸部与身体，深色缰绳从马头弯向骑手。骑手身着蓝灰甲胄端坐，腰部与关节处点缀含蓄赭色。浅蓝裸露骷髅头在甲胄肩部上方朝左，深色眼窝与牙齿标记清楚。深红披风从肩上沿人马右侧垂下。一条弯曲腿贴在马身旁，下部形体局部融入壁画底部的草形与低矮剪影。赭色长杆由下部中央斜穿至右上，末端为宽阔尖矛头。骷髅后方是一圈不均匀的浅橙圆环，局部被人物和长杆遮住，环内仍可见红色。深蓝天际线般的形状沿底部升起，左侧尤其明显，细塔与宽阔马身构成对照。零星小痕迹打断其余红色区域。画中形体采用宽阔棱角色面与局部阴影，墙面粗糙网格仍透过画作显现。均匀环境光同时显出壁画及砌块表面。红色矩形、光环般圆圈与斜向长矛组织紧凑骑乘剪影，形成鲜明而有旧感的街头绘画构图。
style_prompt_en: The style presents bold mural painting on a visibly weathered masonry surface. Saturated red fields contrast with slate blue and teal masses, while pale ochre accents establish a circular focal rhythm. Broad angular planes and selective dark contours simplify volume without eliminating internal shading. Scuffed pigment, fine cracks and block seams remain visible across the painted areas, giving the flat geometry a physical, worn texture. A strong diagonal crosses the central mass and an incomplete circular shape, with small irregular marks softening the surrounding field. Even ambient light preserves the colour-block contrast and the rough surface detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格是在明显风化砌块表面上的鲜明壁画。饱和红色域对照石板蓝与青绿大形，浅赭色强调建立圆形焦点节奏。宽阔棱角色面和选择性深色轮廓简化体积，但保留内部明暗。磨损颜料、细裂纹与墙块接缝透过绘画区域显现，使扁平几何关系具有真实粗旧肌理。一道强斜线穿过中央大形及不完整圆形，小块不规则笔痕让周围色域略显松动。均匀环境光保留色块反差与粗糙表面细节。
theme_en: A red-cloaked skeletal rider on a blue-grey horse
theme_zh: 蓝灰色马背上的红袍骷髅骑手
name: Saner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
